subject: Zenport renewal: conditional price hold + surge-offset proposal
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@zenport.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@zenport.io>, procurement@zenport.io
Date: 2027-03-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: upcoming contract + surge concerns

Hi Irene,

Hope you're well. Our current agreement with Redwood runs through April 30. We're seeing a planned product launch in Q3 that could increase inference volume materially (roughly 1.1-1.4x baseline for 8-12 weeks). Before we lock in our renewal, procurement asked whether Redwood can offer: 

- a short-term price hold for the first 90 days post-renewal, or
- a surge-offset / temporary credit bucket we can draw from if usage spikes, or
- an alternate commit structure that smooths unit price during the launch window.

Can you share options and an example P&L impact? We also want to schedule a quick call with procurement and finance next week. I've attached a compact usage forecast and the launch window estimates for context (attachment: usage-metrics-q4.csv).

Thanks — Ellie

--
Ellen Park
Head of Platform, Zenport
ellen.park@zenport.io

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@zenport.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: upcoming contract + surge concerns

Hi Ellen — thanks for the context and the forecast (got the CSV). We can definitely structure a renewal to protect you for the launch window. High-level options below — I left pros/cons and the fast path to signature at the bottom.

Option A — 12-month (standard) + 90-day price hold: 
- 10% base renewal discount off list for 12 months
- 90-day post-renewal price hold (no list increases)
- surge-offset credits: one-time bucket (50k tokens) to apply to overage in launch window
- Minimal contract amendment (fast)

Option B — 18-month with committed uplift: 
- 15% discount on committed volume (committed = baseline * 1.15)
- Price hold for the first 180 days after renewal if commit met
- Burst pool available (subject to pre-buys) with discounted overage rate

Option C — Conditional price hold + staged credits (recommended if launch uncertainty remains):
- 12-month term with a conditional 90-day price hold that triggers when usage remains <= 1.2x baseline for first billing cycle
- If usage spikes above 1.2x, apply surge-offset credits after 75% threshold (i.e., first 75% of spike covered by credits, rest billed at tiered overage)
- This lowers immediate cash impact and keeps unit economics intact for both sides

Attached: a quick pricing model we can run with your forecast to show $ impact (I'll CC Ben who has the sheet).

Next steps: can you confirm the expected peak multiplier (1.1 vs 1.4) and whether procurement wants a PO or DocuSign? Happy to join a call on Wed/Thu.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@zenport.io>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: upcoming contract + surge concerns — pricing scenarios attached

Ellen / team — attaching three quick scenarios (conservative, expected, aggressive) based on the forecast you shared: pricing-model-scenarios.xlsx. Highlights: 

- Conservative scenario (1.1x peak): Option A saves ~9% YoY cash vs paygo; surge credits cover expected excess.
- Expected (1.25x): Option C reduces peak month bill by ~28% compared to pure paygo.
- Aggressive (1.4x): Option B is the best long-run economics but requires higher committed spend up-front.

Operational note: surge credits are applied as a billing credit line item tied to the invoice that covers the launch month(s). Credits don't roll beyond 90 days unless we agree to extend.

What we need from procurement to finalize: 
1) confirmation on preferred option (A/B/C)
2) whether Zenport can commit to a capped burst pre-buy if choosing Option B
3) a target date to execute the amendment/MA (we can get a v3 draft ready)

I'll join the procurement call and run the scenario numbers live.

— Ben
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing-model-scenarios.xlsx

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@zenport.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@zenport.io>, procurement@zenport.io
Date: 2027-03-23T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: upcoming contract + surge concerns — procurement preference

Thanks Ben / Irene. Procurement ran the numbers and they're leaning toward a conditional price hold (Option C) with the following asks: 

- Conditional price hold for first 90 days after renewal, triggered unless monthly usage > 1.2x baseline in the first month
- Surge-offset credits equal to 60% of estimated excess usage during the launch (Zenport proposes a 75k-token credit pool)
- If usage exceeds 1.5x baseline, Zenport would accept a short term elevated overage rate (we're OK with a tiered overage structure)
- Procurement needs the MA with the conditional clause and the credit mechanics by EOD Friday to review legal redlines

Can Redwood confirm we can do a 75k credit pool and that credits will be applied as invoice line items? Also, would you accept a PO + signature via DocuSign?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ellie

Subject: Internal: Zenport ask — recommended counter and next steps

Team — quick internal note after Ellen's procurement email. Summary of Zenport asks: conditional 90-day hold, 75k surge credits, credits applied as invoice line items, DocuSign/PO path, legal wants MA by EOD Friday.

Recommended counter (keeps momentum, mitigates risk):
- Accept conditional 90-day price hold with a trigger as proposed, but cap credit pool at 60k tokens (tradeoff for speed)
- Surge credits applied as invoice credit line items and expire after 90 days; credits only usable for overage beyond baseline + 20% buffer
- If usage exceeds 1.5x baseline in any month, apply tiered overage: first 1.5x at reduced overage rate, >1.5x at standard paygo rate
- Include a one-time right-to-audit clause for the launch months to confirm baseline and spike calculations

Action items:
1) Ben — update pricing model and the MA v3 with the 60k credit number and tiered overage language (I'll attach the Zenport_MA_renewal_draft_v3.pdf once updated).
2) Monica — prep an internal finance note on revenue recognition impact and any billing setup needed for credits.
3) Jordan — coordinate a Thu 10:00 AM PT call with Zenport procurement + Rajiv for legal redlines.

If we can get signoff from CS/Finance, we push a DocuSign MA and accept PO route. I think this keeps Zenport close and keeps the launch protected.

Irene
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
